description: Standalone local-first provider and model registry with Ollama discovery, health receipts, persistence, import, export, and an optional Hearthgate adapter.

hierarchy.inheritance: Universal Horizon is the sky. Hearthfire: Arkfire and Hearthgate: Arkfire 0.002 operate beneath it and do not supersede it. This module runs on its own and may connect to either host through an optional, reversible adapter.

hostAdapters.disconnectBehaviour: The standalone module continues running and retains its own data.

consentRequirements.note: MF-001 does not send prompts or project content to providers.

networkRequirements.purpose: Reach configured Ollama endpoints for health and model discovery.

lifecycle.install: Run the NSIS installer or unpack the portable ZIP.
lifecycle.launchStandalone: Launch Arkfire Model Foundry or run npm start.
lifecycle.enableInHost: Connect the optional adapter to the module base URL.
lifecycle.pause: Stop issuing probes; the service remains readable.
lifecycle.disableInHost: Disable the host adapter without stopping the module.
lifecycle.removeFromHost: Delete only the host adapter record.
lifecycle.uninstallStandalone: Use Windows Apps or remove the portable directory.
lifecycle.restore: Install or unpack again, then import a prior export bundle.

importProcedure: POST an arkfire.model-foundry-export/v1 bundle to /api/import or use the standalone UI.
exportProcedure: GET /api/export or use Export Registry in the standalone UI.
healthChecks: registry store is readable and writable
each configured provider reports available or unavailable honestly
acceptanceTests: launch with Hearthfire and Hearthgate absent
report an unavailable endpoint without crashing
import the exported bundle into an empty data directory
build an unsigned Windows NSIS installer and portable ZIP

provenance.contribution: Existing four-port Ollama health probing inspected and preserved as source lineage.
provenance.author: Boxfire

provenance.contribution: Existing model endpoint and model-name definitions inspected; dispatch remains untouched during MF-001 extraction.
Installer conventions reused without creating a runtime dependency on Hearthgate.

knownLimitations: MF-001 discovers and records models but does not invoke them.
Cloud provider calls, route recommendations, cost estimates, and consented prompt transfer are deferred.
The Hearthgate adapter contract is present but host-side installation is not yet implemented.
Installer builds are unsigned until code signing is configured.
The module remains PARTIAL until CI and a second reviewer provide standalone and packaging receipts.
